callees.name: position_to_offset
callees.pre_condition: self is a _SourceIndex instance whose source attribute is initialized. lsp_position is a dict with 'line' (non-negative integer) and 'character' (non-negative integer; UTF-16 code units) entries.
callees.post_condition: Returns the 0-indexed byte offset within self.source that corresponds to the given LSP position. Lines are zero-indexed, characters counted in UTF-16 code units (surrogate pairs consume 2 units). Out-of-range positions are clamped: a line beyond the last line resolves to the offset after the final character of the source; a character beyond the line length resolves to the offset after the last character of that line.
